written: 2026-11-01, after run 8 and before any L1/L2 pull or run
source: docs/research/SPRINT_PLAN.md Amendment 7 + Amendment 11 (commit 68a3b1e); Amendment 10 A1 (noise_sh) and B2
description: The final locked-period exam: FIN-H, FIN-L, FIN-HS (FIN-H with B2 confidence sizing) and NB-VOL (the vol-sized noise band in shares), each run once on L2 and once on L1 through the --locked/--frozen guard. Research only.

pull.vixy_daily: VIXY (split-adjusted, one request from vixy_daily_from to the period end)
pull.cache: data/alpaca_exam/<period>/ (the period only; the 1-minute warm-up is read from data/alpaca/)

blocks.name: reference
blocks.why: otm_v1-040 unfiltered (the reference for FIN-H, FIN-L, FIN-HS)

blocks.name: fin_h
blocks.why: otm_v1-040 + relative volume at the signal bar >= 1.06 (FIN-H)

costs.options: desk fills; MODELED-SPREAD half-spread 2% of premium (SPY/QQQ/IWM), floor $0.005; logged chains never used; $0.65 per contract per side; PF 2x = the 2x-slippage P/L stamped on every trade
costs.shares: fill at the open of the bar after the decision +/- $0.01 a share; 2x costs = $0.02 a side; no commission

FIN-L.fit_on: all HIST 11:00-call trades: hist_v1-005 if present, else factory_hist_v1-012

FIN-HS.sizing: P(win) <= lower tercile cut -> 0 contracts; >= upper cut -> 2; otherwise 1

NB-VOL.notional: 10000 x min(4, 0.02 / sd of the 14 prior daily close-to-close returns)

references.FIN-HS: reference (shown); the bar compares P/L per contract with FIN-H
references.NB-VOL: random direction on the same entries and exits

verdicts.holds: passes on both L2 and L1 (then a new versioned PAPER ledger and 40 forward trades; never real money without Nick's explicit yes)
verdicts.mixed: passes on one period (reported, not promoted)

one_shot: Each period runs once. A crash may be re-run with the same frozen spec and the same code commit. Any code change after the first L1/L2 read makes the exam void for that finalist, and it is reported as such.
